name: Farewell
overview: Scripture reveals that farewells are moments marked by God's blessing and providential care, as seen in the LORD's promise to bless and keep His people (Numbers 6:24). Believers can depart with confidence, knowing that God orders their steps and delights in their way (Psalms 37:23), and that He holds thoughts of peace and a hopeful future for them (Jeremiah 29:11). Even in parting, the assurance that all things work together for good to those who love God (Romans 8:28) offers comfort and joy, reflecting the deep gladness found in God's presence (Psalms 21:6) and the help that comes from Him (Psalms 121:1).
